integrity: Proof given for every positive width; exhaustive finite checks are supporting verification, not an infinite proof. Original Schur-ring definitions and prior partial results are credited.
limitations: Classification restricted to a two-row rectangular band, not all rectangular bands.
Counts labeled partitions, not isomorphism types or realizing subgroups.
Equivalent results may exist in incompletely indexed literature.
title: All Schur rings on two-row rectangular bands are automorphic: classification and weighted-Bell enumeration
